title: APAC Dedicated Capacity launch playbook + new instance SKU coordination

comments: 2025-03-04 Asha Patel: Initial ticket to centralize GTM tasks for APAC Dedicated capacity launch and two new instance SKUs (v2-small-gpu, v2-large-gpu). Goal: one coordinated playbook for PM/Eng/Design/Marketing/Sales/Support.

2025-03-06 Miguel Ortega: Kickoff meeting notes uploaded to Confluence - https://confluence.redwood.ai/dedicated/apac-launch-playbook. Action items: finalize SKU names, pricing anchors, and tentative rollout region list (ap-northeast-1, ap-southeast-1).

2025-03-10 Eng (Priya Singh): Confirmed kernel compatibility for v2-small-gpu on h100 nodes; fallback path required for a100 until autoconfig PR lands (GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8421).
2025-03-14 Design (Elliot Rowe): Preparing dashboard + onboarding tiles for console; initial mockup shared in Drive - https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0B_mockups/apac-dedicated-onboarding.

2025-03-22 Legal (Hiro Tanaka): Data residency checklist flagged two controls for APAC: KMS region-bound policy and audit log retention parity. Security review in progress.

2025-03-25 PM (Asha): Updated playbook with rollback criteria and canary thresholds. Canary plan: 5 customers or 10% of reserved capacity for first 48 hours. Metrics to monitor: per-route latency P95, token units/sec, error rate.
2025-03-28 Eng (Priya): Autoscaler hook for reserved pools merged - GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autoscaler/pull/219; assigned ENG-4056 to harden throttling behavior.

2025-03-30 Marketing: Draft release notes and blog outline in Notion - https://notion.redwood.ai/apac-dedicated-launch. Suggested headline: 'Redwood Dedicated arrives in APAC: new instance SKUs and reservation plans for enterprise workloads.'

2025-04-01 Miguel: Consolidated final checklist. Blocker: finance sign-off on billing tier labels (accounting ticket FIN-88). Working with Revenue Ops to finalize reservation terms (12m vs 3m commit).
